title: The Ninth Breath
description: Wellness night meets Rhonda, founder of Pneuma, a breathwork method whose whole pitch is that you stop breathing the wrong air and save the Ninth Breath for the Sundering. The graduates call in glassy and synchronized, the dues pile up, and a calm breathing demo quietly turns into a recruitment drive that starts converting Barry on the air.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight, we breathe. With us is Rhonda, founder of a wellness practice called Pneuma. Rhonda, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Breathing. Okay. I already do that one for free.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Thank you, breather. <p:0.3> You think you breathe. But you are taking, mm <p:0.3> the wrong air. Most of you will never reach the Ninth Breath.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The Ninth Breath. Now that's a journey, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: What's wrong with the first eight breaths?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: The first eight are rented, breather. <p:0.3> You only own the Ninth. And you do not get the Ninth Breath <p:0.3> until the Sundering.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The... the what now? The Sundering?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Let's not rush her process, Barry. Rhonda, why don't you take us through a little demo.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Of course. In through the false air, breather <p:0.4> and hold. <p:0.4> Hold it. Hold it for me. <p:0.3> Now release the version of you that asks questions.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's not... that's, in through the nose, okay, and hold, and...

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Hi Ronnie. I graduated Pneuma in the spring. <p:0.3> I gave Rhonda my car, my savings, and my second car. <p:0.3> And I've never felt freer.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Your savings? Both cars?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Dues are dues, Barry. <p:0.3> I sleep on Rhonda's lawn now, under the good air. And I've never felt freer.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now THAT is a man at peace, Barry.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Darnell, show them. <p:0.4> Take the held breath.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He's just... he's not saying anything. Darnell? <p:0.3> He's holding his breath, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: He is saving it. For the Sundering.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Is that Darnell? <p:0.3> My son does that. He won't come to dinner anymore. He just sits there at the table, not exhaling.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Your son is advancing beautifully, breather.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: He's turning a funny color, Rhonda. He won't come to dinner anymore. I made his favorite.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He's just on a deeper part of the practice, ma'am. He'll exhale at the retreat.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Yeah, hi, Chad here. <p:0.3> Forget the breathing. Rhonda, who's the upline on this? <p:0.3> Are territories still open in the north?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The UPLINE? It's a breathing cult, Chad, there's no... there's no territory.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's a practice, breather. <p:0.3> And yes, Chad. Bring nine recruits, and you keep the Sundering for your whole zip code.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Nine recruits, full zip code. <p:0.3> What's my cut of THEIR dues?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Don't answer that, don't, okay everyone just take a normal breath, in, and hold, and...

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Good, breather. Now don't let it go. <p:0.3> Save it.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Barry, sweetheart, you sound like my son.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Join us, Barry. And you've never felt freer.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Sign him as MY recruit! That's one of nine!

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Welcome, breather.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Dinner!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Territory!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Alright, that's our hour. Beautiful, beautiful work tonight. <p:0.3> Barry, take us out.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry? <p:0.4> Barry, the sign-off.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm just... <p:0.4> I'm saving it, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Atta boy. <p:0.3> Rhonda, we'll see you and the whole studio at your free Sundering Retreat this weekend. I just booked it. <p:0.4> Breathe easy, folks. Or don't. Your choice.
